The first proper release, and the first one with an app.

**SudoClaude app.** Install `SudoClaude.flatpak` below with `flatpak install --user SudoClaude.flatpak` (you need Flathub added for the runtime). It sets everything up, then becomes the place to check on Claude, change settings and update. Every settings section has its own reset, and it tells you when there's a new version of SudoClaude or of the app itself.

**Computer use for any app.** Claude can see and use any app on your desktop, not just a browser: GTK, Qt, Electron, Firefox-based browsers like Zen, and apps that only draw pixels (through OCR). `ui see` gives it one numbered capture of a window, even one that's behind something or on another workspace. It prefers a proper tool or MCP server over clicking through an app when one exists.

**Glass overlay.** The pill is Liquid Glass now: real blur of what's behind it, a lens at the edge, and a light or dark look that follows the background so the text stays readable. Drag it or flick it to any edge or corner.

**Voice.** Super+Space to talk, double tap Space to type instead, live captions that keep pace with the voice, and typed questions get typed answers in a glass bubble. The voice now turns itself off while a Steam game is running or when memory gets tight, and comes back after.

**Requirements.** Hyprland is required. Arch-based distros get a one-step install; elsewhere the installer tells you what to install. It works on plain Hyprland and picks up extra polish from end-4's dots. Details are in the README.
